the training regulation, word for word the same as QĐ 1175/QĐ-KHTN Điều 1–23 (qd-1175-2021), which the advisor already cites; the handbook leaves out Điều 24.

appendix to the Quy chế công tác sinh viên: a table of violations and penalties that the text layer interleaves cell by cell, so a violation reads next to another row's penalty. Rebuilding its rows from the layout text is a follow-up.
appendix to the rèn luyện regulation: the conduct-score table, interleaved the same way (a criterion next to another criterion's points).

Phụ lục I to the khen thưởng, kỷ luật regulation, from the line PHỤC LỤC I on PDF page 147: the discipline table, interleaved the same way. Điều 11 of the regulation states the penalty ladder in prose and is kept.
a directory of security staff phone numbers: personal data.
tips for new students (documents, driving licence, passport, safety) and bus routes: outside the advisor's scope.

notes: Page numbers in citations are the printed ones (PDF page minus 2).
The contents page calls the calendar "Kế hoạch năm học 2023 - 2024"; the calendar pages themselves are for 2024–2025.
Small tables that stay readable (the exam durations in khảo thí Điều 8, the scholarship classes in học bổng Điều 3) come through as one line in reading order, not as tables.
